scripts.build:ts: bun build worker/src/entry-ts.ts --outfile dist-ts/index.js --target browser --format esm --external 'cloudflare:*'
scripts.build:rust2: wasm-pack build core-wasm --target web --release --out-dir ../worker/gen --no-pack && bun build worker/src/entry-rust2.ts --outfile dist-rust2/index.js --target browser --format esm --external 'cloudflare:*' --external '*.wasm' && cp worker/gen/spike_core_wasm_bg.wasm dist-rust2/
scripts.build:rust1: wasm-pack build core-one --target web --release --out-dir ../worker/gen-one --no-pack && bun build worker/src/entry-rust1.ts --outfile dist-rust1/index.js --target browser --format esm --external 'cloudflare:*' --external '*.wasm' && cp worker/gen-one/spike_core_one_bg.wasm dist-rust1/
scripts.build: bun run build:ts && bun run build:rust2 && bun run build:rust1
